tools.description:
Diagnose whether a workflow can be published, and if not, exactly why.

Publishing requires the current draft graph to hash to the same value as the
last successful full run. The bare ``is_publishable`` flag hides the reason;
this reports the concrete causes — no full run yet, leftover inline code on
code-bearing blocks, or a draft that differs from the last run in its blocks,
their configuration, their edges or their order — with what to do about each.
Run it when a publish is being refused and the reason is not obvious.

Args:
    params: workflow_id.

Returns:
    A flat object with ``workflow_id``, ``publishable``,
         ``latest_execution``, and ``reasons`` and ``suggestions`` as
         lists — one entry per cause found, in plain words. When the draft
         differs from the last run, ``block_diffs`` names each block added,
         removed, retyped or with changed config keys, and ``edge_diffs``
         each edge added, removed or rewired.

tools.description:
Search row data across every table at once, grouped by table.

Use this when the value is known but the table is not — "do we have this
vendor anywhere", "which table holds this GL code". When the table IS known,
docsumo_get_table_rows with ``q`` is the better call: it can also filter and sort.

Args:
    params: The search text, an optional kind filter, and
        pagination.

Returns:
    JSON ``{"data": {"results": [...], "total": N, "offset": N,
         "limit": N, "search": bool}}``. ``results`` groups the matching rows
         by table, in relevance order: each group is ``{table_id, name, kind,
         rows: [...]}`` and each row has the same shape as a row from
         docsumo_get_table_rows, with linked_record cells left as raw ``row_id``s.
         ``total`` counts every matching row across all tables, not just this
         page. ``search`` reports whether the search index was used or a
         slower pattern scan replaced it; the fallback has no relevance
         ranking and no typo tolerance. A term that matches nothing returns an
         empty ``results`` with ``total: 0`` and no ``search`` key.

kind.description: Restrict the search to 'reference' or 'entity' tables. Omit to search both.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: Maximum matching rows to return (1-100). Default: 20.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of matching rows to skip for pagination. Default: 0.
